ctor.rationale: `base(3, CardType.Power, CardRarity.Rare, TargetType.Self)` (EternalArmor.cs:22-25) == cost 3 / POWER / RARE / SELF. NOTE it does NOT override GainsBlock even though PlatingPower grants block each turn, so the sim's `gains_block` default of False is right and Nimble's CanEnchant refuses it on both sides -- the same distinction cards/base.py:65-69 draws for Feel No Pain.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new PowerVar<PlatingPower>(9m)` (EternalArmor.cs:20) == `_plating = 9`. `_plating` is in `Card._MAGIC_ATTRS` (cards/base.py:185-189) so `magic_number` surfaces it and the observation encoder sees the right number -- contrast card/feel_no_pain, which stores the same kind of power amount in `_block`.

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<PlatingPower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars["PlatingPower"].IntValue, Owner.Creature, this)` (EternalArmor.cs:29) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, PlatingPower, self._plating, applier=ctx.player)`.
